rates.refund_administration_fee: lesser of $5.00 or 20% of the applicable referral fee

structure: Two layers. (1) Selling plan: Individual = $0.99 per item sold, no subscription; Professional = $39.99 per month 'when you have active listings', no per-item fee. (2) Referral fee per unit sold, charged 'When the buyer's order is shipped': Referral fee = max( (item price + delivery charges + gift-wrap charges) x category rate , per-item minimum referral fee ). Base = 'total sales price' = total amount paid by the buyer including item price and any delivery or gift wrapping charges, 'excluding any taxes calculated through Amazon tax calculation services'. Minimum is $0.30 per unit for most categories; categories shown as '--' have no minimum (Fine Art, Gift Cards, Grocery and Gourmet, Media, Video Game Consoles, Video Games and Gaming Accessories). Tiered categories come in two kinds: 'portion' (marginal) tiers where each rate applies only to the slice of the total sales price inside the band (Compact Appliances, Electronics Accessories, Fine Art, Furniture, Jewelry, Watches), and 'whole_price' tiers where the rate is picked by the total sales price bucket and applied to the entire price (Baby Products; Beauty, Health and Personal Care; Clothing and Accessories; Grocery and Gourmet; Lawn Mowers and Snow Throwers). (3) Closing fee: flat $1.80 per unit sold in Books, DVD, Music, Software & Computer/Video Games, Video Game Consoles, and Video Game Accessories, in addition to the referral fee. Seller pays all of the above (deducted from the buyer's payment before deposit). Amazon 'collects the lower of the applicable fees stated below and any fees communicated to you by Amazon (such as promotional fees)'. Refunds: Amazon returns the referral fee minus a refund administration fee (lesser of $5.00 or 20% of the referral fee). Rounding rules are not stated on any loaded page.

structure: Listing is free. When tickets sell, StubHub deducts a 'sell fee' from the seller's listed price; the seller's payout is 'Price per ticket' with the sell fee subtracted. StubHub publishes no fixed percentage: the sell fee 'adjusts based on ticket price, time to event, updated event information, and supply and demand' and is shown to the seller only inside the listing flow (Set Your Price page > question mark under payout) and in listing/sale details. Buyers separately pay a service fee plus a fulfillment fee at checkout (also no set percentage); StubHub shows 'all-in' prices including fees. The User Agreement defines all of these as 'Service Fees' that 'may vary depending on various factors, including event type, Ticket type, optional features selected by you (e.g., Sponsored Listings), and location' and may be offset against amounts owed to the seller. Payout: the help center says payouts 'are processed within 8 business days after the event'; the Seller Policies say sellers 'will usually be sent payments within five (5) business days (sometimes longer) following the event', or in some cases within five business days of confirmed buyer receipt. Payout methods: PayPal or bank transfer; no StubHub surcharge for PayPal. Penalties (not fees on a normal sale): if the seller drops the sale or delivers invalid tickets, StubHub charges the greater of 100% of the ticket price or its full remedy cost; failing to respond to an invalid-ticket investigation can add 20% of the original ticket cost. Rounding not stated.

rates.bump_rate: seller-chosen percentage of final sale price, charged only if the Bumped listing sells

structure: Two mandatory fees on every sale, both deducted from the Reverb Payments payout (nothing charged at listing). (1) Selling fee = 5% of the total sale amount including shipping ('inclusive of all costs except sales tax' per the Billing Policy), with a $0.50 minimum and a $500 maximum (the cap is hit at a $10,000 sale; above that the fee stays $500). (2) Payment processing fee = 3.19% of the order total + $0.49 per transaction for standard sellers, or 2.99% + $0.49 for Reverb Preferred Sellers; the base is the full order amount including shipping AND any applicable tax. Reverb advertises this as '8.19% + $0.49 Total Fees' and '91.8%' kept (the 91.8% ignores the $0.49). Optional: Reverb Bump is a seller-set percentage (0.5% to 30%) of the item's final sale price, charged only if the Bumped listing sells, deducted from product amount + shipping (tax excluded), in addition to the two fees above. Add-ons: +1% cross-border fee when buyer and seller bank accounts are in different countries; 2.5% currency conversion on payout subtotal if listing currency differs from payout currency. If fees cannot be deducted from a payout they go on the month-end statement. Payout timing: first sale, funds available 1-2 business days after delivery; subsequent sales, 1 business day after a valid tracking number shows movement; then 1-4 business days to reach the bank (help-center quick answer: 2-5 business days). Items over $2,000 USD: payout 3-6 business days after delivery. Rounding not stated.

structure: Etsy Payments processing fee (US bank account): 3% of the total sale price + $0.25 USD flat per order. Base = 'gross order amount, including shipping and tax (if applicable)' / 'the item’s total sale price, including its shipping fees, and any applicable sales tax'; charged on each Etsy Payments transaction (including orders paid through integrated PayPal, gift cards, credits, and coupons); deducted from the payment in the seller's payment account before deposit. On partial/full refunds the processing fee is recalculated on the adjusted sale price and the difference credited proportionally; not credited when Etsy itself covers the refund under its Protection Program. Separate Etsy fees: listing fee $0.20 USD per listing, charged when a listing is published or renewed (auto-renews every 4 months, and again per additional quantity sold), whether or not it sells; transaction fee 6.5% of the display price + shipping + gift-wrap (+ personalization) charged per sale and, for US sellers, NOT applied to sales tax. Currency conversion 2.5% only if listing currency differs from payment-account currency. No deposit fee or minimum for US sellers (deposit fees apply only to the nine listed non-US markets). All fees listed exclusive of VAT; US sales tax may be applied to certain fees. Rounding not stated.

A. Overview. Etsy charges a fee (the “Payment Processing Fee”) for each transaction processed through Etsy Payments. The fee amount will be assessed on the gross order amount, including shipping and tax (if applicable). Payment Processing Fees will be reflected in your payment account and will be deducted from the total amount of the payment at the time the payment is considered complete.
B. Fee Amount. Payment Processing Fees vary based on the location of a seller’s bank account.

In the event of any partial or full refunds credited back to a buyer by a seller, the Payment Processing Fee and other applicable fees will be recalculated based on the adjusted sale price. The difference between the original Payment Processing Fee and the adjusted Payment Processing Fee will be applied to the refund amount being credited back to the seller.

Payment processing fees are a set rate plus a percent of the total sale price of the item. This rate and percent vary by country. The fees are taken from the item’s total sale price, including its shipping fees, and any applicable sales tax.
These processing fees appear in your payment account and are deducted prior to deposit.
Payment processing fees are in addition to the 6.5% transaction fee that applies to the cost of the entire order.
The payment processing fee is assessed on the total amount of the sale, including tax and shipping. Payment processing fees are deducted from the sale amount in your payment account.
The standard Etsy Payments Payment Processing Fee (described below) applies to orders that go through integrated PayPal; there is no additional PayPal fee.
Etsy also charges the Etsy Payments payment processing fee described above on Etsy Gift Card, Etsy Credit, and Etsy Coupon transactions.
You will be charged a listing fee of $0.20 USD for each item that you list for sale on Etsy.com or Etsy's mobile apps.

You will be charged a listing fee whether or not the listed item sells, unless you create a private listing, in which case you will only be charged the listing fee when the private listing is sold. Etsy.com listings expire after four months.
If you list multiple quantities of the same item, the initial listing fee will be $0.20, and the listing will be automatically renewed at $0.20 after each of the items sells.
When you make a sale through Etsy.com, you will be charged a transaction fee of 6.5% of the price you display for each listing plus the amount you charge for shipping and gift wrapping.
If you sell from the US, the transaction fee will not apply to sales tax.
Etsy charges 6.5% of the total order amount in your designated listing currency.

As an Etsy Payments user, if you decide to list in a currency other than that of your payment account, you will be charged a 2.5% currency conversion fee on the sale amount to send funds to your payment account.

C. Listing Currency Conversion Considerations for Sellers. When a seller lists and subsequently sells an item in a currency other than the currency of the seller's payment account, Etsy will settle the associated transaction proceeds in the currency of the seller's payment account. When such a service is required, Etsy applies an additional 2.5% currency conversion fee.

E. Instant Transfer (US seller only). Eligible U.S sellers may use instant transfer to make transfers from their Etsy Payment account directly to their bank account, subject to a fee. Please note that if applicable, an instant transfer fee will be charged and displayed as part of the transfer process.
